question: What question did Jesus ask before healing the man with the shriveled hand?
options: Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?
Who among you has never sinned?
Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar?
Who is the greatest in the kingdom?
explanation: Jesus asked whether it was lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it.
